about_the_game:
Welcome to Music City, a neon-lit cyberpunk world where music reigns supreme.

In this sprawling metropolis, entertainment drives the economy, and bands—with the music they create—are the beating heart and soul of Music City. Take on the role of an ambitious band manager, building your own legendary group from the ground up.

Sign talented musicians, plan concert tours, manage your band, and battle rival groups—every decision you make shapes your band's destiny. In this fiercely competitive industry, you'll balance your members' personalities and demands, respond swiftly to unexpected challenges, and build your fame within the dazzling chaos of Music City.

Are you ready to write your own legend? Lead your band to the top, and rise through the ranks of Music City's entertainment elite!
